'''Elliirad''' was a world located within the [[Airam sector/Legends|Airam sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. A [[Battle of Elliirad|space battle]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] took place near the planet during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="XWvTF" />
